run_server_shutdown_tests: run the ServerShutdown unittest class to test gRPC server clean shutdown on interpreter exit
test_deallocated_server_stops: test that a gRPC server stops when its Python instance is garbage collected
test_server_exception_exits: test that a gRPC server exits cleanly when an exception is raised during operation
test_server_fork_can_exit: test that a gRPC server can exit after a fork on non-Windows platforms
cleanup_processes: kill all tracked subprocesses using a thread-safe lock to prevent orphaned processes
